cards.card_text: Here's how they put it: 'Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.' I think I know that feeling, friend, because I spent years in the back of a junk drawer.
cards.verse_text: Then He said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.’
